# Vendor Agreement

This text is a placeholder. A lawyer replaces it before any real vendor is invited. Read it as a list of the rules the store plans to ask for.

## 1. Purpose

You supply goods that the store sells to its customers. The store takes the orders, collects the payment and decides which vendor location fulfils each order. This agreement sets the rules you follow when you fulfil an order for the store.

## 2. Customer and Vendor Anonymity

Customers buy from the store. They never learn who you are, and you never learn more about a customer than you need to fulfil the order. The store does not name you to customers, and you do not name yourself to them.

## 3. No Direct Customer Contact

You do not contact a customer by phone, message, email or any other way, and you do not answer a customer who contacts you. Send any customer question or problem to the store through the portal.

## 4. No Vendor Papers in Parcels

You do not put your own invoice, brand material, logo, name, phone number or web address in a parcel or on its packing. The store supplies or approves the paper that goes in.

## 5. Data Handling

You use a customer's name and address only to fulfil the items assigned to you. You do not copy, keep or share them, and you delete any local copy after the parcel is delivered.

## 6. Processor Clause

You process customer data only on the store's written instructions and only for the purpose in section 5. Detailed terms are pending the lawyer.

## 7. Fulfilment and Suspension

You fulfil assigned orders within the time the store states. The store may suspend your access at any time, and a suspended vendor cannot see or fulfil any order.
